syllabus_topics: Introduction to signal processing, including historical aspects and modern applications
Introduction to digital processing and filtering
Notions of noise, coding, and information security
Retrieving a periodic signal embedded in white noise, synchronous detection
Linear deconvolution in the presence of measurement noise, application to weak force reconstruction
Analysis of a signal processing problem, implementation of a computerized solution and submission of an analysis report
assessment_rules: First session: project grade (50%) + exam grade (50%). Resit is an oral exam, providing additional points to the initial average.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
